title: thelypteris aspidioides var. subhastata
intro: Thelypteris aspidioides var. subhastata, commonly known as the Japanese fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. This plant is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of T. aspidioides var. subhastata include anti-histamine, anti-allergic, and anti-inflammatory actions, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins.
